description: Zero-dependency Python library that detects whether the current process runs inside a container (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, containerd, LXC and others) on Linux, with a cached result. Python port of the is-inside-container npm package.
rules: Import is_inside_container from container_detect. It always returns False on macOS and Windows.
The result is cached; call is_inside_container(force_refresh=True) to check again.
